headline: H200 and B200 rental prices climb over the past week while older GPUs hold flat.
bullets: H200 rose +9% over 7 days to a $5.40 market index, and B200 rose +6% to $7.99, the steepest gains in the tracked set.
H100 SXM edged up +1% to $4.32, while MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were unchanged at +0%.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with a $10.68 hyperscaler median against $4.07 at neoclouds.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with RunPod Community Cloud listing it at $0.50, though only 5 providers offer it.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite its low $2.70 index.
watch: Whether H200's +9% and B200's +6% weekly gains continue into next week, signaling tightening supply of current-generation capacity.
